photoikku is a new application that lets you place "haiku" or "senryu" over an image to create a new form of poetry. Lay out up to 5 lines on the photo of your choice and you have your very own a visual poem. So easy to create and also to send just at that moment when you feel inspired, it makes for a wonderful way to share it with *words and images put together in a unique expression of yourself. This new mode of the age old art of creating verse gives new meaning to "poetry in motion".

(*Only Japanese and English can be input.)
